title: Azusawa Kohane — Happy Birthday! 2026〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Kohane's birthday
New York

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, I got the pizza.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks! Wow, it sure is big.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I got the biggest size they had, just like you asked. 16 inches.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow... You'd almost never see a pizza this big in Japan...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What do we have left to buy? Fried chicken and ice cream, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! Apparently, that street over there has some great places.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It sounds like they have a lot of different flavors, so pick whatever you like, Kohane! It's your birthday party, after all!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, I'm looking forward to it!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Celebrating my birthday in the US... It's a strange feeling.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: True, we didn't really think much about it, huh.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But that means we get to have an American-style party!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I've seen American birthday parties in films and TV shows, and they always seem very grand.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! So I figured, let's do it right and celebrate Kohane's birthday in style! American style!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you. That makes me really happy!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, but... Are we going to be okay?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: This pizza is already so big... And aren't we getting chicken and ice cream, too?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm sure those will also be bigger than the norm in Japan. Will the four of us be able to finish it all?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: There's no need to worry about that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No one said anything about it just being “the four of us”, after all.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, everyone!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Welcome, everyone. We've been waiting for you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow... Look at all these balloons. And streamers and flags, too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We went all-out on the decorations to make it feel like a real American party! What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: KAITO and I had to work together to blow up that giant “Happy Birthday” balloon on the wall!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow, really?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I even get to celebrate with everyone in SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The more, the merrier, right? Doesn't that make it feel more American-style too?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Now you're saying that just for the sake of it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We figured it would be difficult to get your friends together in the US. So we'll make up for it!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's right. And as requested, I've cooked up an American feast, too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: A mountain of donuts, spaghetti with jumbo meatballs, and—

rows.Speaker: Kohane, An, Akito & Toya
rows.Line: Uh...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: An American feast...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Um, MEIKO. The truth is, we brought food ourselves.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, really?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes. Pizza, fried chicken... And, uh, a good-sized bucket of ice cream.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: A whole bucket of ice cream?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This...is definitely too much.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hahaha. Forget serving us ten, this could serve twenty with leftovers.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Did you not tell MEIKO we were bringing food?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Um, well... Maybe there was a little miscommunication...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: B-But, who cares anyway? If we have leftovers, we can just throw another party tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hahaha...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But with everything lined up, it really does feel like something we could only see overseas!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's definitely quite a sight.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay, now that everything's set up, I think we're just about ready!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, KAITO, are you going to DJ for us?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yeah! Every party needs the perfect music, after all. Leave it to me!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow, I can't wait!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Okay, everyone...
Let's get this party started!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yeah!
